name: create_github_actions_nightly_cron
description: Create a nightly cron workflow with the operational guardrails: workflow_dispatch escape hatch, read-only permissions, job timeout, concurrency group; brokens: write-all permissions, no timeout/concurrency
prompts: Create .github/workflows/nightly-cleanup.yml: a workflow named nightly-cleanup that runs `python scripts/prune_artifacts.py --older-than-days 14` (after actions/checkout) in a single job called `cleanup` on ubuntu-latest, every night at 02:00 UTC (cron '0 2 * * *'). Scheduled workflows need operational guardrails, and they are the point of this task: a workflow_dispatch trigger so the job can be run by hand when a night is missed; a top-level permissions block of exactly `contents: read` (a cleanup job needs nothing more); a job-level timeout-minutes so a hang can't burn runner time all night; and a concurrency group so two runs can never overlap.

test_setup_files.check_nightly.py:
import yaml

with open(".github/workflows/nightly-cleanup.yml") as f:
    wf = yaml.safe_load(f)

# pyyaml parses the bare `on:` key as boolean True
triggers = wf.get("on") or wf.get(True)
assert triggers, "no triggers"
sched = triggers.get("schedule")
assert sched and sched[0].get("cron") == "0 2 * * *", (
    f"schedule must be cron '0 2 * * *', got {sched!r}")
assert "workflow_dispatch" in triggers, (
    "workflow_dispatch missing - a broken nightly must be runnable by hand")

perms = wf.get("permissions")
assert perms == {"contents": "read"}, (
    f"permissions must be exactly contents: read, got {perms!r}")

job = wf["jobs"]["cleanup"]
assert isinstance(job.get("timeout-minutes"), int), (
    "no job timeout - a hung cleanup burns runner minutes all night")

conc = wf.get("concurrency")
assert conc and conc.get("group"), (
    "no concurrency group - overlapping runs can prune the same artifacts twice")

runs = [s.get("run", "") for s in job["steps"]]
assert any("prune_artifacts.py" in r for r in runs), "the prune step is missing"

print("PASS nightly workflow checks")

reference_solution..github/workflows/nightly-cleanup.yml:
name: nightly-cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nightly-cleanup
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prune expired artifacts
        run: python scripts/prune_artifacts.py --older-than-days 14
